_comment: Upstream design-pattern tracker for win4r/agy-wiki (MIT for quickstart-derived parts; port of win4r/claude-wiki). ERC adopts compatible zero-LLM deterministic patterns only (fact-line lifecycle tags valid_from/valid_to/retracted, --against non-destructive fact survival check, optional current-picture summary block & page size hygiene, pre-query orientation map with chronological source timeline, answer citation existence check, trap-case retrieval eval, stdlib-first read-only document inspection / scanned-PDF detection, and 5-class evidence-grounded consolidation retro). Headless agy/claude subprocess runners, cron daemons, quota/token budget schedulers, mandatory pip converters, and replacing ERC's 4-tier vault layout with entities/ + 6 per-unit folders are excluded because they conflict with ERC's zero-LLM scripts, researcher-in-the-loop gates, subscription quota guardrails, and economics S1-S12 pipeline.
name: agy-wiki
label: agy-wiki
policy: design-pattern-only; native rewrite in ERC; headless autonomous runners, cron daemons, mandatory pip deps and vault layout replacement are excluded
last_audit_note: Full architectural audit of README.md, docs/upstream/SPEC.md, src/wiki/*.py, prompts/*.md and rules/knowledge-wiki.md. Adopted 5 compatible deterministic patterns natively across wiki_lint.py, kb_search.py, ingest-source, query-wiki, wiki-lint and Templates/literature-note.md; auto-adapted to Claude Code, Antigravity (agy) and Codex CLI via build_platform.py.

adopted_patterns.note: native rewrite in wiki_lint.py: optional [source: id | as-of: YYYY-MM-DD | valid_from/valid_to/retracted] validation, lint --against <ref> non-destructive survival invariant, current-picture block & page-size hygiene
native rewrite in kb_search.py & query-wiki: orient (aliases + MOCs + chronological timeline), check-cites, eval trap_refusal_rate, reported vs projection distinction & CONFLICT reporting
native rewrite in wiki_lint.py inspect: read-only stdlib-first pre-check for txt/md/csv/html/eml/docx/xlsx/pptx with UTF-16/GB18030 support and optional pypdf scanned-PDF refusal
native rewrite in wiki-lint §3b: WRONG/MISS/DOCS-ONLY/UNPLACED/CONFLICT failure taxonomy, transcripts-as-leads source verification, diff-only approval
